visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair and glasses, wearing a white t-shirt and a black backpack, stands in a brightly lit indoor retail space. He holds a tall, blue and white patterned paper cup with a black lid and a white straw. He smiles at the camera, then takes a sip. (2) The scene shifts to a close-up of the cup and the man's face as he talks. Behind him, the background is a blur of mall elements and warm lighting. (3) The man is seen at a counter, interacting with a staff member. The staff member's hands and arms, wearing a black uniform, are visible as they gesture towards a receipt or menu. The cup sits on the counter. (4) Screenshots of digital documents with text and diagrams are displayed, showing brand information and ingredient lists. (5) The man is back on screen, drinking from the cup again. He looks off-camera while swallowing. (6) A large digital menu screen is shown, displaying various tea options with prices and labels. (7) A staff member behind a stainless-steel counter prepares multiple drinks in identical patterned cups. They are wearing a black cap, mask, and uniform.
